reason: Confirmed: the generic free-space check in TC-005 (tests/responsive-layout.spec.ts:732) is vacuous when the wrapped value follows the growing item cell. But it measures exactly what the TC-005 Then states, the case's concrete criteria (Prices/offer/Status on one line, labels shown) are checked and pass, and flex-wrap breaks lines on the 14rem basis, so the current CSS meets FR-RESPONSIVE-024. The tests are locked, so this is a test-strengthening follow-up, not a defect in this PR.
title: Strengthen TC-005 wrap check after the growing item cell
todo:
**Problem:** In `tests/responsive-layout.spec.ts:729-734` (TC-005), the check "a value starts a new line only when it does not fit" computes free space as `card.right - previous.right`. The item cell has `flex: 1 1 14rem` (`src/index.css`, `td:has(> .item-cell)`), so it always grows to the end of its line and `free` is about 0 whenever the wrapped value follows it. A regression such as a much larger item basis (pushing Prices to the next line while it would fit beside the item) would still pass.

**Suggested work:** Measure free space from the previous cells' hypothetical sizes (flex-basis or max-content width, e.g. via `window.layoutProbe`) instead of the grown border box, or add an explicit check that Prices sits on the item's line when `14rem + Prices width` fits in the card. Update TC-005 in `doc/changes/2026-11-19-2053-issue-165-use-all-space-to-show-item-list-when-the/testcases.md` if the wording changes.

title: Align TS-RESPONSIVE-017 wording with the growing item cell
todo:
**Problem:** `doc/specifications/responsive-layout/technical.md:117` (TS-RESPONSIVE-017) states "Cells do not grow, so the free space left on a line is always smaller than the next cell's width", which contradicts TS-RESPONSIVE-023 (line 136) and `src/index.css` (`td:has(> .item-cell) { flex: 1 1 14rem }`, `td:has(> .row-actions) { margin-inline-start: auto }`).

**Suggested work:** Reword to e.g. "Value cells do not grow; only the item cell grows into the space left on its line, and the actions cell is pushed to the line end (TS-RESPONSIVE-023)."

title: Merge card td display rule into the tbody td block
todo:

todo:
